comment: The handoff to Play is files on disk rather than an expander connection, so what is captured belongs to the user rather than to the patch. The sweep holds the gate for the sustain time, records the tail after release, waits for silence if the menu says so, then moves on; at the end the files are trimmed and normalised according to the menu settings before being written with an SFZ file beside them.
